mapper.select: SELECT c.name FROM repairer_specialty_category s JOIN repair_category c ON c.id = s.category_id WHERE s.repairer_id = #{repairerId} AND c.enabled = 1 ORDER BY c.name, c.id
SELECT b.name FROM repairer_responsible_building a JOIN building b ON b.id = a.building_id WHERE a.repairer_id = #{repairerId} AND b.enabled = 1 ORDER BY b.name, b.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.phone, COUNT(t.id) AS activeTicketCount FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.assignee_id = u.id AND t.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') WHERE r.role_code = 'REPAIRER' AND u.enabled = 1 AND ( NULLIF(TRIM(#{keyword}), '') IS NULL OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{keyword}), '%') OR u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', TRIM(#{keyword}), '%') ) GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.name, u.phone ORDER BY u.id;

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.name, u.phone, COUNT(t.id) AS activeTicketCount, u.enabled FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN ticket t ON t.assignee_id = u.id AND t.status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'CLOSED') WHERE r.role_code = 'REPAIRER' AND u.id = #{id} GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.name, u.phone, u.enabled
